verdict.headline: Euclidean + LHS is better early on; by the time every feature is found the two are level
reasons: Finished first in 45 of 112 paired starts with LHS, 41 without (26 ties, sign test p = 0.75).
Lower error after 60 runs in 75 of 112 starts with LHS, 37 without (p = 0.00042).
Finished 96 of 112 with LHS against 96 without; the stop rule was wrong 3 time(s) with LHS and 3 without.
The 12 opening runs' closest pair is 0.26 apart with LHS against 0.07 at random; the biggest hole shrinks from 0.44 to 0.30.
